key.name: preferences-migrated
key.description: Whether preferences have been migrated from Typesetter.

key.name: autosave
key.description: Whether to automatically save files with a known path.

key.name: centered-scrolling
key.description: Whether to center the active line vertically on the screen as the user types.

key.name: check-grammar
key.description: Whether to enable grammar checking in the editor.

key.name: check-spelling
key.description: Whether to enable spellcheck in the editor.

key.name: highlight-current-line
key.description: Whether to highlight the current line in the editor.

key.name: invert-lightness
key.description: Whether to invert the lightness of pages in the preview when dark mode is enabled.

key.name: pdf-standard
key.description: The PDF standard to use when exporting.

key.name: preview-divider-position
key.description: The pixel position of the draggable divider between the editor and preview pane (-1 for default 50/50 split).

key.name: scroll-preview-on-type
key.description: Whether to automatically scroll the preview to the current position in the editor.

key.name: show-bundled-templates
key.description: Whether to show bundled templates in the template picker.

key.name: show-explorer
key.description: Whether to show the file explorer sidebar.

key.name: show-preview
key.description: Whether to show the preview pane by default when opening a new window.

key.name: style-scheme
key.description: The style scheme to use in the editor.

key.name: theme
key.description: The theme to use throughout the application.

key.name: vim-mode
key.description: Whether to enable Vim keybindings in the editor. Can be enabled with: gsettings set dev.whetstone.editor vim-mode true
